Tests archive extraction with custom security limits

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, SecurityLimits, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com/archives/documents.zip")
    config = ExtractionConfig(security_limits=SecurityLimits(max_archive_size=104857600, max_compression_ratio=50, max_files_in_archive=100))
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].mime_type)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
